clues: This town lies in the Darfur region of western Sudan. It lies far north-east of Nyala, deep in the west of Sudan.
This land has three seasons in its year, not four. First comes a bone-dry cool spell, then fierce dry heat, then one short wet spell with near all the rain.
In October 2025, after a siege that had lasted a year and a half, this town fell. The Rapid Support Forces took it in the midst of a civil war.
For ages, this town was a post where trade caravans stopped and rested. That old caravan role is the heart of its early tale.
This town is the capital of North Darfur state. Its rule and its markets draw folk from all the farms round it.
